friendlyTitle: Usagi-org/ai-goofish-monitor: an AI watcher for listings on Xianyu
summary: ai-goofish-monitor watches Xianyu, Alibaba's secondhand marketplace, with Playwright, and uses a model to score listings against criteria you set. It includes a web admin screen for tasks, results, and alerts. The latest tagged release is 2.5, on 9 October. The default branch last changed on 10 October. MIT. GitHub's Python trending list showed 204 stars today, and about 16,300 in total.
friendlySummary: ai-goofish-monitor watches Xianyu, Alibaba's secondhand marketplace, with a browser tool called Playwright. It uses a model to score listings against rules you write. It includes a web admin screen for tasks, results, and alerts. The latest tagged release is 2.5, on 9 October. The main branch last changed on 10 October. The license is MIT. GitHub's Python trending list showed 204 stars today, and about 16,300 in total.
whyItMatters: Use it if you shop on Xianyu and want a scheduled search that keeps the listings matching a written brief, instead of refreshing the app. It runs through a browser session you provide, so the marketplace login is yours to protect. It does not help on a marketplace it was not built for.
